content.value: A three-throw reciprocating pump delivering $0 . 1 m ^ { 3 } / s \mathrm { o f }$ water against a head of 100 m. Diameter and stroke length of the cylinder are 25 cm and 50 cm réspectively. Friction losses amount to 1 m in the suction pipe and 16 m in the delivery pipe. If the velocity of water in the delivery pipe is 1.4 m/s, pump efficiency 90% and slip 2%, Determine the pump and the power required.
